# The allow-list of the US English spelling check (JYRO-ADR-196 item 8).
#
# Each entry is a phrase, matched with no case sensitivity. A flagged form is
# accepted where it lies inside an occurrence of an entry on its line. An entry
# names an external name outside the control of Jyro that is itself spelled
# with a flagged form - a command of another tool, a name of a third-party API,
# quoted third-party text - and nothing else: a word of the project's own is
# respelled, never allowed.

# The FLOORS command that analyzes a defect.
floors defects analyse
# The FLOORS Next skill of the same name.
floors-next:analyse
